    // eight corners, with no cube edges. Coordination 8 at both the center and
    // the corner. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cubic_crystal_system)
    BodyCenteredCubic(_: LatticeUnitCell): LatticeUnitCell
        => LatticeUnitCell(
            LatticeUnitCell.CubeCorners.Append(Point3D(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)),
